title: Retail fill length on Prescriptions & Renewals prescriptions
content:
**To retail pharmacies receiving Prescriptions & Renewals prescriptions from Linden Ridge patients.**

A prescription the patient moves to a retail pharmacy is dispensed there in fills of the retail standard of 30 days. The retail fill length is recorded on the prescription at the moment the patient moves it, and it is the days' supply every later fill of that prescription dispenses at the retail pharmacy.

**How the retail fill length is set.** The retail fill length is the shortest of four allowances, each worked out on the day of the move in whole days: the payer allowance, the adherence allowance, the authorization-span allowance and the visit allowance, and it never exceeds the largest days' supply per fill of the prescription's class. Each of these allowances is the retail standard of 30 days.

Put another way, the retail fill length is the shortest of the four allowances, or the class's largest days' supply per fill where that class figure is shorter still.

**Worked figures (hypothetical moves).**

| Class of the prescription moved | Shortest allowance | Class's largest days' supply per fill | Retail fill length |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Maintenance Prescription | 30 days | 90 days | 30 days |
| Schedule III-V Controlled Prescription | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days |
| Acute Short-Course Prescription | 30 days | 14 days | 14 days |

**Recording.** The figure is fixed once, on the day of the move, and every later fill of that prescription at the retail pharmacy dispenses that many days.
